name: auditmanager
description: Welcome to the Audit Manager API reference.

subcommands.name: associate-assessment-report-evidence-folder
subcommands.description: Associates an evidence folder to an assessment report in an Audit Manager assessment.

subcommands.name: batch-associate-assessment-report-evidence
subcommands.description: Associates a list of evidence to an assessment report in an Audit Manager assessment.

subcommands.name: batch-create-delegation-by-assessment
subcommands.description: Creates a batch of delegations for an assessment in Audit Manager.

subcommands.name: batch-delete-delegation-by-assessment
subcommands.description: Deletes a batch of delegations for an assessment in Audit Manager.

subcommands.name: batch-disassociate-assessment-report-evidence
subcommands.description: Disassociates a list of evidence from an assessment report in Audit Manager.

subcommands.name: batch-import-evidence-to-assessment-control
subcommands.description: Adds one or more pieces of evidence to a control in an Audit Manager assessment.

subcommands.name: create-assessment
subcommands.description: Creates an assessment in Audit Manager.

subcommands.name: create-assessment-framework
subcommands.description: Creates a custom framework in Audit Manager.

subcommands.name: create-assessment-report
subcommands.description: Creates an assessment report for the specified assessment.

subcommands.name: create-control
subcommands.description: Creates a new custom control in Audit Manager.

subcommands.name: delete-assessment
subcommands.description: Deletes an assessment in Audit Manager.

subcommands.name: delete-assessment-framework
subcommands.description: Deletes a custom framework in Audit Manager.

subcommands.name: delete-assessment-framework-share
subcommands.description: Deletes a share request for a custom framework in Audit Manager.

subcommands.name: delete-assessment-report
subcommands.description: Deletes an assessment report in Audit Manager.

subcommands.name: delete-control
subcommands.description: Deletes a custom control in Audit Manager.

subcommands.name: deregister-account
subcommands.description: Deregisters an account in Audit Manager.

subcommands.name: deregister-organization-admin-account
subcommands.description: Removes the specified Amazon Web Services account as a delegated administrator for Audit Manager.

subcommands.name: disassociate-assessment-report-evidence-folder
subcommands.description: Disassociates an evidence folder from the specified assessment report in Audit Manager.

subcommands.name: get-account-status
subcommands.description: Gets the registration status of an account in Audit Manager.

subcommands.name: get-assessment
subcommands.description: Gets information about a specified assessment.

subcommands.name: get-assessment-framework
subcommands.description: Gets information about a specified framework.

subcommands.name: get-assessment-report-url
subcommands.description: Gets the URL of an assessment report in Audit Manager.

subcommands.name: get-change-logs
subcommands.description: Gets a list of changelogs from Audit Manager.

subcommands.name: get-control
subcommands.description: Gets information about a specified control.

subcommands.name: get-delegations
subcommands.description: Gets a list of delegations from an audit owner to a delegate.

subcommands.name: get-evidence
subcommands.description: Gets information about a specified evidence item.

subcommands.name: get-evidence-by-evidence-folder
subcommands.description: Gets all evidence from a specified evidence folder in Audit Manager.

subcommands.name: get-evidence-file-upload-url
subcommands.description: Creates a presigned Amazon S3 URL that can be used to upload a file as manual evidence.

subcommands.name: get-evidence-folder
subcommands.description: Gets an evidence folder from a specified assessment in Audit Manager.

subcommands.name: get-evidence-folders-by-assessment
subcommands.description: Gets the evidence folders from a specified assessment in Audit Manager.

subcommands.name: get-evidence-folders-by-assessment-control
subcommands.description: Gets a list of evidence folders that are associated with a specified control in an Audit Manager assessment.

subcommands.name: get-insights
subcommands.description: Gets the latest analytics data for all your current active assessments.

subcommands.name: get-insights-by-assessment
subcommands.description: Gets the latest analytics data for a specific active assessment.

subcommands.name: get-organization-admin-account
subcommands.description: Gets the name of the delegated Amazon Web Services administrator account for a specified organization.

subcommands.name: get-services-in-scope
subcommands.description: Gets a list of the Amazon Web Services services from which Audit Manager can collect evidence.

subcommands.name: get-settings
subcommands.description: Gets the settings for a specified Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-assessment-control-insights-by-control-domain
subcommands.description: Lists the latest analytics data for controls within a specific control domain and a specific active assessment.

subcommands.name: list-assessment-framework-share-requests
subcommands.description: Returns a list of sent or received share requests for custom frameworks in Audit Manager.

subcommands.name: list-assessment-frameworks
subcommands.description: Returns a list of the frameworks that are available in the Audit Manager framework library.

subcommands.name: list-assessment-reports
subcommands.description: Returns a list of assessment reports created in Audit Manager.

subcommands.name: list-assessments
subcommands.description: Returns a list of current and past assessments from Audit Manager.

subcommands.name: list-control-domain-insights
subcommands.description: Lists the latest analytics data for control domains across all of your active assessments.

subcommands.name: list-control-domain-insights-by-assessment
subcommands.description: Lists analytics data for control domains within a specified active assessment.

subcommands.name: list-control-insights-by-control-domain
subcommands.description: Lists the latest analytics data for controls within a specific control domain across all active assessments.

subcommands.name: list-controls
subcommands.description: Returns a list of controls from Audit Manager.

subcommands.name: list-keywords-for-data-source
subcommands.description: Returns a list of keywords that are pre-mapped to the specified control data source.

subcommands.name: list-notifications
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all Audit Manager notifications.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Returns a list of tags for the specified resource in Audit Manager.

subcommands.name: register-account
subcommands.description: Enables Audit Manager for the specified Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: register-organization-admin-account
subcommands.description: Enables an Amazon Web Services account within the organization as the delegated administrator for Audit Manager.

subcommands.name: start-assessment-framework-share
subcommands.description: Creates a share request for a custom framework in Audit Manager.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Tags the specified resource in Audit Manager.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes a tag from a resource in Audit Manager.

subcommands.name: update-assessment
subcommands.description: Edits an Audit Manager assessment.

subcommands.name: update-assessment-control
subcommands.description: Updates a control within an assessment in Audit Manager.

subcommands.name: update-assessment-control-set-status
subcommands.description: Updates the status of a control set in an Audit Manager assessment.

subcommands.name: update-assessment-framework
subcommands.description: Updates a custom framework in Audit Manager.

subcommands.name: update-assessment-framework-share
subcommands.description: Updates a share request for a custom framework in Audit Manager.

subcommands.name: update-assessment-status
subcommands.description: Updates the status of an assessment in Audit Manager.

subcommands.name: update-control
subcommands.description: Updates a custom control in Audit Manager.

subcommands.name: update-settings
subcommands.description: Updates Audit Manager settings for the current account.

subcommands.name: validate-assessment-report-integrity
subcommands.description: Validates the integrity of an assessment report in Audit Manager.
